texts.label: תעתיק
texts.citation: Geoffrey Khan, Arabic Legal and Administrative Documents in the Cambridge Genizah Collections (Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 1993).
texts.html:
1. بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله وحده وكفى وسلام على عباده الذين اصطفى
  2. اقر ابو نصر بن عطية اليهودى الدلال على العطر كان بمصر وهو يومئذ غلام امرد لا نبات بعارضيه ولا بذقنه
  3. مربع القامة للاعتدال صاف السمرة واضح الجبهة صلتها مقرون خفى ابخص اعين اشم وبوجهه نبذ جدرى عند شهود هذا
  4. الكتاب واشهدهم على نفسه فى صحة عقله وبدنه وجواز امره وهو طائع غير مكره ولا مجبر ولا مضطهد ولا جاهل بما اقر به فيه
  5. [ ]اليهودى ولا عليها ولا عندها ولا في ذمتها
  6. [ ] .الدلال على العطر كان بمصر المتوفى ولا بقية من ارث عنه
  7. [ ] ولا .... ولا خبية ولا ذخيرة ولا ذهب ولا فضة ...............

texts.label: תרגום לאנגלית
texts.citation: Geoffrey Khan, Arabic Legal and Administrative Documents in the Cambridge Genizah Collections (Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 1993).
texts.html:
1. In the name of God, the merciful and compassionate. Praise be to God alone, he is sufficient, and peace be upon his servants, whom he has chosen.

  2. Abū Naṣr ibn ʿAṭiyya the Jew, formerly a broker dealing in drugs in Fusṭāṭ, on this day he being a youth with no beard, without growth on his cheeks or his chin,

  3. square in stature, inclining to medium, pure brown (in complexion), with a smooth, broad forehead, with eyebrows linked by an arch of sparse hair, with fleshy eyelids, large eyes, with a fine nose, there being marks of smallpox on his face, acknowledged in the presence of witnesses of this

  4. document, calling people to be his witnesses, he being in sound mind and body, legally capable of conducting his affairs, acting voluntarily, not forced, nor coerced, nor constrained, nor ignorant of what he acknowledged in it

  5. [ …] the Jew, nor does she owe, nor. is there in her possession, nor is she under obligation for

  6. [ … ] the deceased, formerly a broker dealing in drugs, nor is there any remnant of inheritance from him 

  7. [ … ] nor ... nor anything hidden, nor anything hoarded, neither gold, nor silver ...
